description: Writes a new email and saves it to the mailbox's Drafts folder. Nothing is sent: the user reviews and sends it from Spacemail webmail or their mail app.

account.description: Which mailbox to use, by its name or email address. Configured: none configured yet. Required when more than one is set up.

body.description: The message, as plain text. Include a sign-off if appropriate.
